_doc: GH #980. Pack-shaped policy DATA: the governed in-cluster operators that PRODUCE a single Secret. scoped_secret_verbs are the single-object Kubernetes RBAC verbs that unconditionally honor resourceNames (get/update/patch/delete) and so MUST be name-scoped to produced_secret_name when granted on secrets. create (and deletecollection) can never be resourceNames-scoped; list/watch can be, but only when the client sends a matching metadata.name field selector — so the gate does NOT mandate scoping list/watch/create (they remain the documented namespace-wide RBAC floor in the chart, narrowable once the operator binary guarantees a field selector). join_token_values_ref is the Helm values path of the operator-internal bootstrap Secret the operator consumes; the chart must provision it declaratively or fail-close on its absence.
